entries.name: serverRegisterCompletionProvider
entries.summary: Register package-provided completion metadata and bounded static keyword/snippet items for Clay's server-side completion framework. Phase 18.19 adds inert snippet text-format, exclusive provider claim, and structured item descriptors.

custom_properties.description: Full package.json-shaped manifest; when provided, Clay validates its completionProviders metadata directly.

custom_properties.name: packageName
custom_properties.description: Package name used for provenance when a load entry passes one provider descriptor.

custom_properties.name: packagePrefix
custom_properties.description: Package apiPrefix used for provider ID ownership and provenance.

custom_properties.name: permissions
custom_properties.description: Must include completion-provider.

custom_properties.name: completionProvider
custom_properties.description: Inert completion provider descriptor matching clay.contributions.completionProviders.

custom_properties.name: providerId
custom_properties.description: Package-prefixed provider ID such as example.words.

custom_properties.name: triggerCharacters
custom_properties.description: Inert trigger characters. They request completion but never execute callbacks.

custom_properties.name: wordBoundaryChars
custom_properties.description: Inert word-boundary characters used by providers to split tokens.

custom_properties.name: items
custom_properties.description: Bounded inert static keyword/snippet items. Strings become both label and insertText with textFormat plainText; structured objects carry label, insertText, optional detail, and optional textFormat.

custom_properties.name: exclusive
custom_properties.description: When true and this provider matches at the highest priority tier, suppresses all strictly lower-priority matching providers while preserving equal-priority peers.

custom_properties.name: textFormat
custom_properties.description: Per-item text format. Snippet items carry inert LSP placeholder syntax expanded client-local on accept.

custom_properties.name: priority
custom_properties.description: Higher priority providers are considered first; ties are deterministic by ID.

custom_properties.name: timeoutMs
custom_properties.description: Provider timeout budget, bounded to 1..=5000.

custom_properties.name: maxItems
custom_properties.description: Per-provider item cap bounded by COMPLETION_RESULT_MAX_ITEMS.

entries.security: Requires completion-provider permission and server-side package record validation of provider ID ownership, duplicate IDs/items, trigger metadata, static item/result bounds, timeout/item budgets, and inert load-time metadata. The public API registers inert keyword/snippet items only; JS provider execution tokens are intentionally not exposed. Snippet items carry inert LSP placeholder syntax expanded client-local on accept with no callback, command, or provider code. It rejects handler/callback/complete/function/module, client JavaScript, native handles, raw ops, command side effects, URLs, CSS/raw colors, shell, network, AI, WASM/native/library, package-manager/download authority, and does not grant filesystem, workspace-index, extension loading authority, AI mutation authority, client-side JavaScript authority, raw-op, native-widget, or package-manager authority.

Prefer `loadPackage("@vendor/provider")` from user configuration; do not pass callbacks, raw Deno ops, modules, commands, or UI widget code. Structured snippet items are data; do not pass executable snippet transforms or callback-accept hooks.
